✈️🔥 AIRSHOW WEEKEND IS HERE! 🔥✈️

We’re bringing the CRISPY • CHEESY • DELICIOUS Korean Corn Dogs to the Airshow! 🌭🧀🔥

Come hungry because these are BIGGER, crunchier, and loaded with flavor! 🤤

🌭 Korean Corn Dogs 🔥 Plain — $11
🍬 Cinnamon & Sugar — $13
🥔 With Potatoes — $13
❤️‍🔥 Hot Cheetos — $14
💥 Fully Loaded — $15

Plus your favorite fillings, sauces, fries & 32oz lemonade! 🍋🍟

✈️ Planes in the sky. Corn dogs in your hand.
That sounds like a pretty damn good weekend to me! 😎🔥

📍 AIRSHOW FOOD TRUCKS
Come find Korean Corn Dogs and get your airshow feast on!

#KoreanCornDogs #Airshow #AirshowFoodTrucks #GrandJunction #Colorado #FoodTruck #KoreanCornDog #CrispyCheesyDelicious #AirshowWeekend #GrandJunctionCO

I know the odds aren’t great, but does anyone have a Gizmo 3 (kids watch phone) charger we could borrow for the weekend?! We are leaving for a Thursday- monday sporting event tomorrow late afternoon, a prong broke on our son’s watch charger. Hoping beyond hope we can find one fast because the replacement won’t be here in time, the watch offers us peace of mind while he gets some independence. 🙏

What happened to the billions of tax dollars from marijuanna sales? I thought the whole point of having high weed tax was to help fund stuff like this? Now we have to vote to increase our own property tax...

AI
I love that we are advertising our local events but could we not use AI? It’s honestly lazy and more than half of the time the information is not accurate. If you’re looking to attend these events please make sure to check out their pages to ensure that the information is correct. There’s flyers for these different things that people have actually created and putting into AI defeats the purpose of this.
I just avoided a jury duty scam so I wanted to spread the word that they would not call you for that. I confirmed by calling 911 after the scammer hung up on me. Be safe out there
The view on tonight’s walk.  North of Fruita.
What I got of  sunset in western Colorado looking south towards the Monument 9/30/26.

Needing to find a home for this Calico. She would be great in a single cat home. She has become food aggressive and refuses to let any of our other cats eat. She came to us as a stray about 4 months ago. We have checked with neighbors and they say it’s not their cat.￼ She’s an outdoor cat but seems like she would adapt easily to being an indoor cat. Sweet personality. Not fixed and not sure if she has had any shots.

It’s time for our Grand Opening Event!!

Come see us Saturday October 3rd to check out our one of a kind Bookstore!
We have coffee, baked goods, charcuterie, a unique self serve wine station featuring Colterris wines, in addition to other local wines and beers.

We will have different vendors throughout the day including flash tattoos, a T-shirt bar, specialty cookies, permanent jewelry, and clay creations!

We’ll see you at 7am Saturday!! The first 20 people in the door get a special swag bag 🍷📚☕️

Hi! Did you happen to drop these little buddies while out walking with your kiddos? I put them on the mail box at S. Mesa and E. McCune Ave. across from the police station. Please leave for the rightful owner. Some kid may really be missing their little friends.
